facts.fact: Sep-2026 shareholding pattern filed (excluded under the as-of rule; Screener shows promoters 57.48%, FIIs 7.71%, DIIs 18.86%, public 15.95%, 93,846 holders).
Investec initiates at Buy, target Rs560 (stock Rs457.70): recovery from H2FY27, revenue CAGR 13% and EBITDA doubling over FY26-29; stock at a ~30% discount to Indian CDMO peers.

Q2FY27 results: revenue Rs476.65 cr (-14% YoY), EBITDA Rs35.4 cr (7.4% margin), profit before minorities Rs2.3 cr, profit attributable Rs15 cr, EPS Rs0.40 (Screener quarterly table). Earnings call and deck filed in Nov-2026.
